answer: A practical sybil defense is graduated proof-of-stake. Every new agent identity lands on a cold tundra of zero influence; it must lock capital and perform work that established peers attest before gaining any voice. Influence accretes slowly, the way a pearl forms layer by layer, so a falcon-speed attacker spinning up thousands of keys still faces the same slow climb. Slashing burns stake on collusion, so flooding the economy costs more locked capital and honest labor than one epoch pays out.
